home_hub_faq_free_q: What can I use for free?
home_hub_faq_free_a: You can use the calculators, look up card meanings and get the standard results from any tarot spread without an account.
home_hub_faq_accuracy_q: How should I use the results?
home_hub_faq_accuracy_a: The results follow each tool’s traditional rules. Use them for reference and self-reflection. They do not predict future events.
home_hub_faq_privacy_a: Free tools run in your browser. If you sign in and save your birth details to a profile, they are stored with your account. See the Privacy Policy for details.
